notes.title: Ghosts, Questions, and a Little Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again,[/p][p]This one’s short but spooky 👻[/p][p][i]A Story of Questions[/i] is now part of the [b]Hungry Ghost Festival[/b] on Steam!
It’s a special event highlighting haunting, atmospheric horror games, so if you’ve been thinking about wishlisting, now’s a perfect time.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="F_T6DPRoCJ8;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]A Quiet Month…[/h3][p]You may have noticed it’s been a little quiet around here. That’s because I’ve been working away on something special for the game. I can’t share details just yet, but let’s just say it’s bigger than a plush duck this time 😉[/p][p][/p][p]Every Choice Still Matters[/p][p]In case you’re new here:
[i]A Story of Questions[/i] is a narrative-driven horror mystery about choices.
Small ones, like opening a box or playing a tape.
Bigger ones, like answering a question that may change everything.
Every choice closes a door… and opens another.#[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s Next?[/b][/p][p]For now, I’ll keep building in the background, but I wanted to drop by, share the event, and say thank you for sticking with me even when things get quiet.[/p][p]Your support (and wishlists) mean the world 💛[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621/sale/TheHungryGhostFestival2025" buttoncolor="#3691fa"]👉 [/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45022621/sale/TheHungryGhostFestival2025"]The Hungry Ghost Festival Event Link[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p]- Tim[/p][p]Under the Bridge Games[/p]
